reason: Remove the need for an operator to name or wire any available encoder individually. A general local resource directory offers all supported, verified checkpoints to training and prediction; individual legacy configuration remains supported. Downstream model choice and fusion are still based on task compatibility and training evidence.
raw_run: A fresh anonymous course solve using the full implementation-supported inventory, one resource directory and the ordinary default settings. The launcher strips individual encoder location variables; no model, fusion combination, policy, time limit or training budget is passed by the study. Compare the resulting choices with the larger default-budget run on the same inventory. The external comparison is descriptive on the previously used designated validation. First independently replay the frozen model from the common directory.
limitations: This general adapter discovers supported and cryptographically pinned runtime formats. Installing an arbitrary new architecture or fetching an arbitrary Internet model is a separate capability. No paid model calls, course test or H2.
